ms.report:
During Milestone 2, we completed key management and transaction signing across platforms. Keys are stored securely in WebCrypto, iOS Secure Enclave, and Android Keystore. Send/receive flows functional on testnet with unit tests for persistence and invalid signing. Apple login demo works on Web and iOS; automated tests verify key persistence and failure handling. Negative tests for failed auth ensure keys persist across restarts, laying foundation for cross-platform wallets. To satisfy the reviewers, we provided 2 screenshots showing the Apple functionality(Output C). Additionally, the context Reviewer two provided is a correct interpretation of what we tried to present.

ms.report:
During our final two milestones, we learned a lot about the wallet industry in Cardano. Through market and developer research, we were able to streamline Hodei to make it even better than originally planned. We are proud to present Hodei wallet, live and functioning on Cardano mainnet, in a 6 month time span. The product has already seen adoption through the space as users test the wallet on Wayup, the leading NFT marketplace on Cardano. Here is a link to our consistent reporting document which contains all updates and progress reports from start to finish. 

A. Output: Comprehensive documentation including developer guides, migration and integration examples, and cookbook recipes
Acceptance criteria: API documentation available for developers
Evidence: Link to Documentation

B. Output: Launch of a developer portal with SDK distribution channels, usage guides, and CI validated examples
Acceptance criteria: Developer portal live with SDK docs, examples, and guides published
Evidence: We determined this unnecessary and inhibitive to what we created. A dedicated developer portal is not required, as the integration is straightforward and comparable to other existing wallets. Documentation is available at github.com/Cardano-Forge/hodei-client. 

C. Output: SDK distribution channels
Acceptance criteria: SDK packages / Applications distributed for Web/iOS/Android 
Evidence: The current implementation does not use an SDK, during development we identified this approach as cumbersome and unnecessary for our target user base. Developers can integrate with or without Weld, or simply add "hodei" to the list of supported wallets. End users with the browser extension get the same features as any other wallet. iOS, macOS, and Android applications are available on TestFlight, with an APK available for Android. A web version was not pursued, as it was not aligned with our intended product direction.

D. Output: Private beta program with 3 partner dApps onboarded, collecting structure
